ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels in central lobe regions and 30% low-intensity (black) pixels along boundaries and a central vertical band.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity contiguous white zones occupy the central surfaces of both lobes. These are separated by a distinct low-intensity (black) vertical band at the median notch. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is mapped along the entirety of the trailing edge and the outer lobe margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression located at the central junction of the lobes; pixel depth is shallow relative to the total horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Presence of irregular, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (serration) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, particularly visible on the lobe to the viewer's left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory fitted to the trailing edges of the visible fluke lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical band extending from the median notch toward the leading edge, creating a sharp bisection of the white ventral pigmentation.
